name: Osa★Tsuma Onii-chan ga Danna-sama
original_name: おさ★つま　お兄ちゃんが旦那様
source:
Onii-chan finally becomes childhood friend's husband. The newlyweds can't get enough of their love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
